question: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average runs per match in season 5, along with their batting averages.
sql:
WITH player_match_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pm.player_id,
        m.match_id
    FROM player_match pm
    INNER JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker as player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        bs.runs_scored,
        bb.innings_no
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    INNER JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM player_match_ids)
),
player_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        wt.player_out as player_id,
        wt.match_id,
        wt.innings_no
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    WHERE wt.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM player_match_ids)
),
player_not_outs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pmi.player_id,
        pmi.match_id
    FROM player_match_ids pmi
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM player_wickets pw 
        WHERE pw.player_id = pmi.player_id AND pw.match_id = pmi.match_id
    )
),
player_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        pmi.player_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(pr.runs_scored), 0) as total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pmi.match_id) as matches_played,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pn.match_id) as not_out_matches
    FROM player_match_ids pmi
    LEFT JOIN player_runs pr ON pmi.player_id = pr.player_id AND pmi.match_id = pr.match_id
    LEFT JOIN player_not_outs pn ON pmi.player_id = pn.player_id AND pmi.match_id = pn.match_id
    GROUP BY pmi.player_id
),
player_stats_enhanced AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        ps.total_runs,
        ps.matches_played,
        ps.not_out_matches,
        ps.total_runs * 1.0 / ps.matches_played as avg_runs_per_match,
        ps.total_runs * 1.0 / (ps.not_out_matches + 1) as batting_avg
    FROM player_stats ps
    INNER JOIN player p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id
)
SELECT * FROM player_stats_enhanced
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5
